meta.title: AgentBridge — Safe Git & GitHub Architecture
meta.subtitle: Separation of Local Git Operations from Remote GitHub Services
meta.description: Architectural model reflecting clean separation between Local Git operations (.git source of truth on workstation) and remote GitHub REST services, gated by centralized permission engine and workspace locks.

components.label:
Telegram ChatOps UI
(sutra/apps/telegram/formatting.py)
components.description: Renders Git hub overview, status cards, bounded diffs, interactive mobile file staging, commit prompts, push confirmation, and PR triggers.

components.label:
Telegram Callback Handler
(sutra/apps/telegram/callbacks.py)
components.description: Routes user callbacks, maintains file staging selections, coordinates permission checks before executing high-risk Git mutations.

components.label:
ControlPlane Gateway
(sutra/control_plane.py)
components.description: Enforces permission precedence policies, validates git.* command schemas, routes frames over authenticated TLS WebSocket connection.

components.label:
LocalRuntime Dispatcher
(sutra/runtime.py)
components.description: Coordinates workspace lock enforcement, validates project boundaries, routes git.* commands to the clean AgentBridge Git Service layer.

components.label:
AgentBridge Git Service
(sutra/git/__init__.py)
components.description: Unified Git façade coordinating local subprocess adapters and remote GitHub API clients with structured data models.

components.label:
Local Git Adapter
(sutra/git/local.py)
components.description: Direct subprocess interface to local .git repository: porcelain v1 status parsing, branch inspection, staging, committing, and pushing.

components.label:
GitHub REST Adapter
(sutra/git/github.py)
components.description: Async HTTP client managing GitHub pull request creation, remote URL parsing, and token detection (no GitHub MCP dependency in core).

components.label:
Workspace Lock Manager
(sutra/workspace_lock.py)
components.description: Prevents concurrent mutation conflicts between active agent file writes and human Git staging/commits.

components.label:
Permission & Policy Engine
(sutra/permissions.py)
components.description: Classifies Git risks (READ=LOW, STAGE=MEDIUM, COMMIT/PUSH/PR=HIGH, FORCE=CRITICAL) and enforces explicit human approval.

components.label:
Secret Redaction Filter
(sutra/redaction.py)
components.description: Centralized regex sanitizer protecting secrets, tokens, and private keys in diffs and commit summaries before transmission.

relations.label: Local operations (status, diff, stage, commit, push)
